front.zh: 現代俳句 & 變奏   系列《20》

en: Beneath the umbrella
Walking the same street scene
Wind is still wind, rain is still rain

points.zh: 宋代的青源禪師有過這樣一段話：「老僧三十年前來參禪時，見山是山，見水是水；及至後來親見知識，有個入處，見山不是山，見水不是水；而今得個體歇處，依然見山還是山，見水還是水。」
points.en: The Song Dynasty Chan master Qingyuan once said: "Thirty years ago, before I began practicing Chan, I saw mountains as mountains and waters as waters. Later, when I gained some insight through the guidance of a wise teacher, I reached a point where I saw that mountains are not mountains, and waters are not waters. But now, having found a place of true rest, I see once again that mountains are just mountains, and waters are just waters."

en: Flowers that bloom in summer
Within autumn's colors, retreat
Reincarnated into snowflakes filling the sky
The temple bell tolls slow, and I
Facing east or facing west, still
Wearing dust, touched by dew, rising and sinking through the human world
Remembering you
You are an ink-wash painting
Late spring, willows drooping tenderly
King Solomon, looking down
Lilies of the wild field
Waving a sleeve, leaving in silence

points.zh: 新約聖經馬太褔音書第6章28 ~ 29 節 : 「何必為衣裳憂慮呢？你想，野地裡的百合花， 怎麼長起來，它不勞苦，也不紡織，然而我告訴你們 : 就是所羅門王極其榮華的時候，他所穿戴的還不如這花一朵呢！」有人認為這是新約聖經最美的一段經文，「你想，野地裡的百合花」，是意境悠遠，富含詩意的一句話。耶穌把百合花和所羅門王的榮華對比，百合花遠勝於所羅門王身上的華麗，遠勝於所羅門王的—切，遠勝於他所建造的聖殿，統領的國土。—朵百合花遠勝於世上所有人為的事物。去野地看看百合花吧！安靜地思想神的奇妙，恩典和慈愛。也許透過—朵百合花，透過神的創造物，要比去聖殿敬拜，去哭牆懺悔，更能親近神，直接和神對話，領悟神的旨意，滋潤鮮活的生命。
points.en: New Testament, Gospel of Matthew, chapter 6, verses 28–29: "And why take ye thought for raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin: yet I say unto you, That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these!" Some consider this the most beautiful passage in the New Testament — "Consider the lilies in the field" is a phrase of far-reaching mood, rich in poetry. Jesus contrasts the lily with the glory of Solomon: the lily far surpasses the splendor upon Solomon's body, far surpasses everything Solomon possessed, far surpasses the temple he built and the land he ruled. A single lily far surpasses all things made by human hands in this world. Go to the field and look at the lilies! Quietly contemplate the wonder, grace, and love of God. Perhaps through a single lily, through this creation of God, one may draw nearer to God — more directly speak with Him, comprehend His will, and nourish a fresh, living life — than by worshiping in the temple or repenting at the Wailing Wall.

en: Just like this
With the willow strands in the wind
Thinking of yesterday's sunset

zh: 如果你始終徘徊在夢裡
en: If you always linger within a dream
In this life, I will remember
How beautiful the moonlight was that night
Where dusk begins, beneath the pines
Asking the boy, is there a hermit here
Lost on a path deep within the clouds?

points.zh:
松下問童子，言師採藥去。
只在此山中，雲深不知處。
--唐 。賈島《尋隱者不遇》
points.en:
Beneath the pines I asked the boy;
he said, his master had gone to gather herbs.
He is only somewhere on this mountain,
but the clouds are deep, and I know not where.
-- Tang dynasty. Jia Dao, 'Seeking the Hermit but Not Finding Him'

en: Though there are flowering trees, fine rain like silk threads
Beneath the umbrella, still longing
The lakeside where we walked that year
When all the lamps of memory are lit
Then I know the direction of the dream
Tomorrow will be better

points.zh:
《 明天會更好 》
填詞 :  羅大佑，張艾嘉，張大春
譜曲 :  羅大佑     編曲 :  陳志遠
玉山白雪飄零，燃燒少年的心
使真情溶化成音符
傾訴遙遠的祝福
唱出你的熱情，伸出你的双手
譲我擁抱着你的夢
讓我擁有你真心的面孔
讓我們的笑容
充满着青春的驕傲
爲明天獻出虔誠的祈祷
明天會更好
points.en:
"Tomorrow Will Be Better"
Lyrics: Lo Ta-yu, Sylvia Chang, Chang Ta-chun
Music: Lo Ta-yu; Arranged by: Chen Chih-yuan
Snow drifts down on Jade Mountain, kindling the hearts of the young
letting true feeling melt into musical notes
that carry blessings to far-off places
Sing out your passion, hold out your hands
let me embrace your dreams
let me hold your sincere face
let our smiles
be filled with the pride of youth
we offer up a devout prayer for tomorrow
tomorrow will be better
